span.p:
Task is persisted.
Initial state is decided
by dependency presence.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Waiting for upstream tasks.
Never dispatched to a worker.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Eligible for scheduling.
No worker assigned yet.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Attempt created and assigned,
but worker has not confirmed
execution yet.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Worker acknowledged the task
and is executing it.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Controller no longer trusts
the in-flight attempt.
A later retry may create
a new attempt.
